## Summary

This change adds a documentation landing page for OctoAcme project management guidance and includes a brief overview of the process lifecycle, communication strategy, role definitions, and quality practices.

## Changes

- Added `docs/README.md` as the documentation index for OctoAcme process docs
- Included a concise summary of the project lifecycle from initiation through retrospective
- Added links to all existing docs in the `docs/` folder
- Included role and quality expectations based on the project management documentation
